SymbolDefinition
W; w,y, zDomain of works (e.g.,images, text); individual works
D TrainDataset D= (w1,...,wn)
p; p(y|x)Training algorithm mapping datasets D to models p
auxConditional generative model; the probability of generating y on prompt x
uAuxiliary information given to the user (usually aux = ideas(w)) User taking input aux and access to p and outputting a work z ← uP(aux)
T；T(E;aux)Real-world distribution; the probability of event z E E in the
C; cprobability experiment p ← Train(D),z ← uP(aux)
SubSim(w)Set of in-copyright works; an in-copyright work Set of works substantially similar to w
ideas(w)Non-copyrightable ideas associated with w
“w'stems from w”w' is a derivative work of w, represented as edges in graph G
CD; C-DIn-copyright works from which some work(CD)/no work(C_D) in D stems
scrub(D,c) T-c; T-c(E;aux)Sub-dataset of works in D that don't stem from c
